general.subtitle: Site-wide settings: logo, home page hero and the banner at the top of each page.
general.logoHint: Shown in the header and footer of every page. A PNG with a transparent background works best.
general.heroImageHint: The large picture next to the home page title.
general.defaultHint: Leave empty to use the default text (shown greyed out in the box).
general.bannersHint: A banner is the dark strip under the menu at the top of each page. Click “Edit” on a page to change its intro line or background image; an empty intro line uses the default text. Detail pages (products, projects, services, articles) share their list page's image.
general.previewNote: Preview: this is how the banner will look on the page (the background image is darkened so the text stays readable).
general.resetIntro: Put the chosen Giải pháp pages back to the website's original content. Use it when a page was edited by mistake and you want to start over.
general.resetWarning: All edits on the chosen pages are replaced by the original content, and photos/videos uploaded only for those pages are deleted. This can't be undone.

general.resetConfirmMany: Restore {n} pages to their default content: {names}? All edits on these pages will be replaced.
general.resetNone: Choose at least one page to restore.
